Troubleshooting: HVAC Repair Services Rajkot Guide to Error Codes

Modern ACs communicate issues via error codes. As part of our HVAC repair services Rajkot, we educate our clients on what these mean so you don’t panic. Here are a few we frequently resolve:

  • E1 / E2: Usually indicates a room temperature sensor failure. We replace the sensor instantly.
  • E6: Communication error between indoor and outdoor units. Often a wiring or PCB issue requiring expert repair.
  • P4: Inverter compressor drive error. This is complex and requires advanced PCB diagnosis by our senior engineers.
  • EC: Refrigerant leak detection. Indicates low gas pressure, which we fix by locating the leak and recharging.
